summary: Wire the 'Предложить гранты' UI panel to a backend proposal endpoint that calls a BYO connected agent (not a platform LLM), returns a structured grant-set as a pending proposal, and activates each grant only after explicit human confirmation via the existing POST /api/grants write-path with proposed_by=<agent-employee-id> and confirmed_by=<admin-id>.
functional: FR-1: POST /api/grants/propose accepts {text: string, role_id: uuid} and returns {proposed: ProposedGrantAtom[]}
FR-2: Proposal is generated by calling a BYO agent registered in agent_card (llm_endpoint + llm_secret_handle); no platform LLM credential
FR-3: POST /api/grants/propose does NOT insert any grant row; proposals are ephemeral HTTP-response-only
FR-4: When admin confirms, POST /api/grants carries proposed_by=<agent-employee-uuid> and confirmed_by=<admin-actor-id>; both recorded in grant row and GrantAuditEvent
FR-5: LLM proposal atoms are structurally validated through parseScopeElement; freeform scope is never admitted from a proposal
FR-6: The validateAdminDelegation gate fires unchanged on the confirmation path (POST /api/grants); LLM-proposed grants obey the same narrowing gate as direct grants
FR-7: Platform returns 503 NO_PROPOSAL_AGENT when no BYO proposal agent is configured; no fallback platform LLM
FR-8: All proposal-path DB and agent lookups are tenant-scoped (withTenant / RLS); cross-tenant proposal is structurally impossible
FR-9: The act of calling the BYO agent is written to audit_event as type=grant.proposal_requested (actor, subject=role_id, via=grant-propose)
non_functional: NF-1: No LLM SDK import, no platform-held API key (OPENAI_API_KEY / ANTHROPIC_API_KEY not required); BYO HTTP call uses plain fetch/node:http
NF-2: Every atom in the LLM response is validated through parseScopeElement before returning to the UI; invalid atoms are dropped silently
NF-3: Freeform scope is stripped from proposal output even if the BYO agent returns it
NF-4: The resolved llm_secret_handle value (actual credential) must not appear in logs, audit rows, or HTTP response bodies
NF-5: Day-1: one proposal agent per tenant identified by a well-known slug or env-var override; multi-agent selection is out of scope
NF-6: src/core/scoped-admin.ts (validateAdminDelegation) is not modified by this task
out_of_scope: Persisting proposals as draft DB objects — proposals are ephemeral (HTTP response only)
LLM confidence scores or reasoning explanation in the proposal response
Streaming proposal response — synchronous request/response only
Explicit reject/dismiss API for individual proposed atoms (rejection is implicit: admin simply does not confirm)
Freeform scope in proposals — structurally excluded
Stage-2 autonomy enforcement (E5.7) and A2A call-graph breakers (E5.8)
Retry/fallback to another agent on proposal failure

acceptance_criteria.text: POST /api/grants/propose with valid body and a configured BYO agent returns 200 with {proposed: ProposedGrantAtom[]} where each atom has resource_type, operation, scope (valid ScopeElement), and optional reason
After POST /api/grants/propose, SELECT COUNT(*) FROM choros."grant" WHERE tenant_id=$t returns the same count as before the call
POST /api/grants with proposed_by=<agent-uuid> and confirmed_by=<admin-uuid> inserts a grant row where proposed_by=<agent-uuid> and confirmed_by=<admin-uuid> (both non-null, not the string 'llm')
The audit_event row for the confirmed grant has proposed_by=<agent-uuid> and confirmed_by=<admin-uuid> (via encodeGrantAuditEvent)
A grant row with confirmed_by IS NULL is excluded from grant_resolver's active-grant query; an unconfirmed proposed grant yields zero capability for the role
A BYO agent response containing scope:{kind:'freeform',...} results in that atom being absent from the proposal response; no 500 error
grep -rE 'OPENAI_API_KEY|ANTHROPIC_API_KEY|sk-[a-zA-Z0-9]+' src/ returns zero matches in non-test production code
POST /api/grants/propose with no proposal agent registered for the tenant returns 503 with error code NO_PROPOSAL_AGENT
After POST /api/grants/propose, audit_event contains a row with type='grant.proposal_requested', actor=<requesting-admin>, subject=<role_id>, via='grant-propose'
Confirming a proposed grant via POST /api/grants with an actor lacking mgmt_object:grant authority returns 403 ADMIN_GATE_REJECTED
POST /api/grants/propose with a BYO agent response containing mixed valid and invalid scope atoms returns 200 with only the valid atoms; no 500 on invalid input
With two tenants having different proposal agents, a request from tenant A uses tenant A's agent exclusively (cross-tenant agent lookup is impossible by RLS + GUC)
The resolved llm_secret_handle credential does not appear in any HTTP response body, stdout/stderr output, or audit_event.payload during the proposal flow
grep -n 'LLM_PROPOSALS' web/src/screens/rights/ra-role-editor.jsx returns zero matches (static mock removed; propose() makes real fetch call)
The proposed_by value in the confirmed grant DB row is a valid UUID matching the proposal agent's employee_id, not the string 'llm'
